title: The Workers in the Vineyard
reflectionText: Everyone who worked received a full day's wage, even those who came at the last hour. The ones who had worked since dawn were not cheated — they got exactly what they had agreed to. What unsettled them was watching the latecomers receive the same. "Is your eye envious because I am generous?" the landowner asked. Whose equal wage has been hard for you to accept?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-07-26, Batch G. Matthew 20:1-16 ONLY.
